scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The FXYD6–Na+/K+-ATPase foundation and Cnr1-defined interneuron context are sound, while the proposed Coro6 anchoring and Ctxn1 competition mechanisms are plausible but highly speculative extensions. The account also simplifies input resistance by linking it too directly to pump-controlled electrochemical gradients rather than membrane conductance.
scores.Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: Fxyd6 was connected to input resistance through Na+/K+-ATPase regulation, with low Coro6 proposed to alter pump anchoring, low Ctxn1 to create a permissive membrane context, and high Cnr1 to identify the relevant interneuron state. Cnr1 remains mainly a subtype marker, and the transition from pump regulation to input resistance is insufficiently resolved. No mechanistic-synthesis ceiling was applied because all three contextual features were explicitly connected to the proposed association.
